sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 865)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across two Superman serial adventures starring Clayton "Bud" Collyer on *The Adventures of Superman* for Kellogg's Pep (sacred talisman in 1948; double double-cross underworld feud in 1950), John le Carré's espionage masterpiece *Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Spy* adapted on BBC Radio 4 (1988), South African police flying squad action on *Squad Cars* (1968), early syndicated dialogue comedy on *Frank Watanabe and the Honorable Archie* (1934), and an orchestral tribute to Spokane, Washington on *Big City Serenade* (1952).
All episode titles maintain pure canonical naming, with multi-part serial numbers cleanly recorded in the `story` attribute and cast/sponsors preserved in the narrative description:
